confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors come from travel-site and aggregator price reports that disagree (beer about $1.50-$8, cappuccino about $2-$6, budget meal about $5-$12). Several reports are undated or skew toward hotel venues, so the values are bounded midpoints. Cocktail and wine are weaker: hotel menus were used to bound them, and cocktail was set against beer. Midrange meal and all accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the city context, not checked against live listings or current bookings. FX: the 2026-11-03 RBA 4pm reference was taken from a third-party market report and was not verified on the RBA page. It is about two weeks older than the generation date.
comparable_city_reasoning: Southern African tourist town with in-town local venues priced well below its hotel bars and lodges. Food and drink were bounded by the observed local-versus-hotel price spread, and accommodation was estimated holistically for a regional tourist centre.
